summary.tldr: Authorizes $149.8 billion in federal spending for the public service for 2025 to 2026.
what_it_does: Authorizes $149,771,149,015 to be paid out of the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the public service of Canada.
Covers expenses of the public service of Canada that are not otherwise provided for for the fiscal year ending 31 March 2026.
Takes effect when it receives Royal Assent.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 17 June 2025 and received Royal Assent on 26 June 2025.
